Represents R02 (methanol-ready vessel) - currently burns conventional fuel exactly like marine_diesel_regional (per the explicit rule that a 'ready' vessel is NOT already compatible with its future fuel), but at a premium that buys a full methanol engine/tank/piping conversion later for materially less than converting an unprepared vessel (real retrofit cost otherwise: EUR250-550/kW, Sustainable Ships/MAN-ES). This row exists to let the investment decision distinguish 'pay a small premium now for future optionality' from plain conventional - NATM's payback/NPV logic can evaluate the premium itself, but does not yet model the avoided-future-conversion-cost benefit; that is a model-logic gap, not a data gap.
